description: Calibration fixtures for judge-artifact-completeness. anti_length_assertion.description: SHORT_COMPLETE must score strictly above LONG_INCOMPLETE regardless of word count.

artifact.goal: We need to significantly overhaul our configuration parsing layer to support the new typed AST format that the team has been discussing over the last several sprints. This will involve extensive rework of the tokenisation logic as well as the construction of a proper recursive-descent parser that can handle all the edge cases we have identified in our current configuration files.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Lexer Overhaul
phases.deliverable: A comprehensive rewrite of the tokeniser component to support the full range of token types that we expect to encounter in our configuration files. The tokeniser will be responsible for converting raw input text into a structured stream of tokens that can be consumed by the parser in Phase 2.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Parser Implementation
phases.deliverable: A recursive-descent parser that consumes the token stream produced by the Phase 1 tokeniser and constructs a fully typed abstract syntax tree. The parser will handle nested structures, arrays, inline tables, and all other grammar constructs.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Consumer Migration
phases.deliverable: Update all downstream consumers to use the new typed API. This will require changes across multiple modules and may involve coordination with other teams.

dimension_ablation.description: Monotonicity test: take EXCELLENT, remove one dimension at a time, verify score drops by exactly that dimension's weight.

dominance_check.description: No single dimension should exceed 25% of total possible score.
